sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lab technician body is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Corpse of a deceased lab technician. A 4x4 loot container that only spawns the TerraGroup science office key.

sections.heading: Ground Zero
sections.text: Inside the TerraGroup main building, in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble.
